messages:
sam_p: EDR alert on my laptop (work-laptop-15). Popup said 'helper loader' was blocked and EDR quarantined a process. Not sure what I clicked — was using Chrome. @irina_sec can you triage?

edr-bot: Detection ID: DET-2026-8823 | Rule: Sideloaded Helper Process | Action: quarantined | SHA256: 3f5e8a1b...c9d2 | PID: 11204 | Parent chain: chrome.exe -> helper-loader.exe -> helper.exe | File path: C:\Users\sam\AppData\Local\Temp\hlp_2973.dll

irina_sec: on it. did EDR isolate the host from network or just quarantine the file? sam_p: can you confirm hostname and whether you used admin creds? Also attach any screenshots.
sam_p: Hostname is work-laptop-15. EDR quarantined and blocked network access. I was not using admin creds, just my normal user. Screenshot: https://redwood.s3/anon/shot123 (screenshot of prompt). I did install an unpacked extension a few hours ago for a side project.
it_ops: creating ticket IT-4321 and initiating remote session. Placing host into network isolate and disabling external internet egress. ETA 5m.
alex_k: good catch. i'll run a fleet hunt for the SHA and parent process chain. suggested EDR query: process.file.sha256:3f5e8a1b* OR process.parent.name:helper-loader.exe OR process.command_line:*hlp_2973.dll*
maria_sre: quick reminder — if any local service account or AWS CLI was used from that host, rotate those credentials. also check KMS access logs for the last 24h for that principal.
irina_sec: can someone pull a full process tree and memory dump (EDR full forensic) and upload to the sandbox analyzer? if sandbox flags it as malware we declare incident. also check persistence (scheduled tasks, registry run keys).
edr-bot: Forensic package uploaded: /edr/forensics/DET-2026-8823/pack.tar.gz. Sandbox verdict: suspicious with persistence indicators (creates scheduled task named 'UpdaterSvc' and drops DLL to AppData).
irina_sec: thanks. alex, prioritize the fleet search. if we see >1 hit escalate to INC and notify legal. For now, reimage policy for any host with execution + persistence. sam_p you should not re-use the laptop until IT finishes reimage; we'll provide a loaner.
sam_p: understood. anything i should do re: passwords or tokens locally?
irina_sec: rotate any local stored tokens (git creds, AWS profiles). we'll check KMS for any Get* or Decrypt calls from that principal in the 24h window and follow up. IT will provide step-by-step for backing up non-sensitive files.
alex_k: fleet hunt results so far: 1 additional hit (work-laptop-42) with same SHA and spawn chain, quarantined. opening follow-up ticket to patch indicators across fleet.
irina_sec: escalation triggered — creating incident INC-2026-0429. action items: 1) full fleet scan for SHA/parent processes, 2) collect forensics from hits, 3) rotate exposed credentials, 4) reimage positives, 5) notify legal/security-comms if any data access found.
it_ops: loaner assigned to sam_p, ticket IT-4321 updated with reimage window.
maria_sre: i've started KMS access review, will post findings in INC-2026-0429 thread.
sam_p: thanks everyone — i'll hand laptop to IT for reimage.
irina_sec: closing this thread — we'll keep INC updated. great cross-team response. :thumbsup:
